ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "The request is malformed, for example the JSON could not be read.", correlationId: correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Resource not found"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Method not allowed"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Not acceptable"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Unsupported media type"}
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Not Implemented"}

logger.message: #["Unexpected error, type=" ++ (error.errorType.namespace default "") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "") ++ ", correlationId=" ++ (vars.correlationId default correlationId)]
logger.doc:name: Log unexpected error

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "SYSTEM_ERROR", message: "An unexpected error occurred. Please quote the correlation ID when contacting support.", correlationId: vars.correlationId default correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {message: "Resource not found"}

logger.message: #["[SIMULATED PROVISIONING] Event received: " ++ payload.eventType ++ ", correlationId=" ++ payload.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log event received

logger.message: #["[SIMULATED PROVISIONING] Creating workspace for tenant " ++ payload.payload.tenantId ++ " in region " ++ payload.payload.region ++ " (data residency " ++ payload.payload.dataResidency ++ ")"]
logger.doc:name: Simulate workspace creation

logger.message: #["[SIMULATED PROVISIONING] Seeding default data for tenant " ++ payload.payload.tenantId]
logger.doc:name: Simulate default data seeding

logger.message: #["[SIMULATED PROVISIONING] Applying licence limits: seats=" ++ (payload.payload.seats as String) ++ ", entitlements=" ++ (payload.payload.entitlements joinBy ",")]
logger.doc:name: Simulate licence limits

logger.message: #["[SIMULATED ACTIVATION] Event received: " ++ payload.eventType ++ ", correlationId=" ++ payload.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log activation event received

logger.message: #["[SIMULATED ACTIVATION] Marking workspace ready for tenant " ++ payload.payload.tenantId ++ ", plan " ++ payload.payload.planCode]
logger.doc:name: Simulate workspace ready

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: vars.errCode, message: vars.errMessage, (resendPath: "/api/v1/customers/resend-verification") if (vars.errCode == "TOKEN_EXPIRED"), correlationId: vars.correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "If this email belongs to an account that is awaiting verification, a new verification link has been sent.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import dw::Crypto import toHex from dw::core::Binaries output application/java --- toHex(Crypto::hashWith(write(payload, "application/json") as Binary, "SHA-256"))

logger.message: #["Registration rejected: Idempotency-Key missing or invalid, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log invalid key

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID", message: "The Idempotency-Key header is required and must be 8 to 60 characters (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore).", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

db:select.doc:name: Look up idempotency key
db:select.db:sql: SELECT request_hash, response_body FROM idempotency_keys WHERE idempotency_key = :key

logger.message: #["Idempotency-Key reused with a different request, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log key reuse

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED", message: "This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. Use a new key for a new registration.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS", message: "A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Please retry shortly.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

logger.message: #["Idempotent replay served from stored response, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log replay

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- read(vars.idemRow[0].response_body as String, "application/json")

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if ((read(vars.idemRow[0].response_body as String, "application/json").code default "") == "PROVISIONING_FAILED") 500 else 201

%dw 2.0 import dw::Crypto import toHex from dw::core::Binaries output application/java var cleanName = upper(payload.company.companyName replace /[^A-Za-z0-9]/ with "") var prefix = if (sizeOf(cleanName) > 8) cleanName[0 to 7] else cleanName var rawToken = (uuid() ++ uuid()) replace /-/ with "" --- { customerId: "CUS-" ++ (now().year as String) ++ "-" ++ ((floor(random() * 900000) + 100000) as String), tenantId: "TNT-" ++ prefix ++ "-" ++ upper(uuid()[0 to 3]), userId: "USR-" ++ upper(uuid()[0 to 7]), token: rawToken, tokenHash: toHex(Crypto::hashWith(rawToken as Binary, "SHA-256")), expiresAtIso: (now() + |PT24H|) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }

db:select.doc:name: Check duplicate email
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id FROM customer_users WHERE email = :email

logger.message: #["Duplicate registration rejected, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log duplicate

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "DUPLICATE_EMAIL", message: "An account already exists for this email. Please sign in or reset your password.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert customer
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, tenant_id, company_name, industry, employee_count, gst_number, address_line1, city, state, postal_code, country, plan_code, seats, billing_currency, region, account_status, marketing_opt_in, terms_accepted_at, correlation_id) VALUES (:customerId, :tenantId, :companyName, :industry, :employeeCount, :gstNumber, :addressLine1, :city, :state, :postalCode, :country, :planCode, :seats, :billingCurrency, :region, :accountStatus, :marketingOptIn, :termsAcceptedAt, :correlationId)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ customerId: vars.ids.customerId, tenantId: vars.ids.tenantId, companyName: payload.company.companyName, industry: payload.company.industry, employeeCount: payload.company.employeeCount, gstNumber: payload.company.gstNumber, addressLine1: payload.company.address.addressLine1, city: payload.company.address.city, state: payload.company.address.state, postalCode: payload.company.address.postalCode, country: payload.company.address.country, planCode: payload.subscription.planCode, seats: payload.subscription.seats, billingCurrency: payload.subscription.billingCurrency, region: payload.subscription.region, accountStatus: "PENDING_VERIFICATION", marketingOptIn: payload.consent.marketingOptIn default false, termsAcceptedAt: (payload.consent.acceptedAt as DateTime) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}, correlationId: vars.correlationId }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert primary user
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customer_users (user_id, customer_id, email, first_name, last_name, phone, job_title, user_role, user_status) VALUES (:userId, :customerId, :email, :firstName, :lastName, :phone, :jobTitle, :userRole, :userStatus)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ userId: vars.ids.userId, customerId: vars.ids.customerId, email: lower(payload.primaryContact.email), firstName: payload.primaryContact.firstName, lastName: payload.primaryContact.lastName, phone: payload.primaryContact.phone, jobTitle: payload.primaryContact.jobTitle, userRole: "PRIMARY_ADMIN", userStatus: "PENDING" }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert token hash
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO verification_tokens (token_hash, customer_id, email, expires_at) VALUES (:tokenHash, :customerId, :email, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR))

logger.message: #["Account creation failed and was rolled back, errorType=" ++ (error.errorType.namespace default "") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "") ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log rollback

logger.message: #["Customer created, customerId=" ++ vars.ids.customerId ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log customer created

email:send.subject: Welcome to the platform – verify your account
email:send.doc:name: Send welcome email

db:update.doc:name: Mark email SENT
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE customers SET email_status = 'SENT', email_attempts = email_attempts + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = :customerId

logger.message: #["Welcome email failed after retries, customerId=" ++ vars.ids.customerId ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log email failure

db:update.doc:name: Mark email FAILED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE customers SET email_status = 'FAILED', email_attempts = email_attempts + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = :customerId

logger.message: #["Provisioning event published, customerId=" ++ vars.ids.customerId ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log event published

db:update.doc:name: Mark PROVISIONING_FAILED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE customers SET account_status = 'PROVISIONING_FAILED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = :customerId

logger.message: #["ALERT: PROVISIONING_FAILED, customerId=" ++ vars.ids.customerId ++ ", tenantId=" ++ vars.ids.tenantId ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Internal alert

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { customerId: vars.ids.customerId, tenantId: vars.ids.tenantId, accountStatus: "PENDING_VERIFICATION", planCode: payload.subscription.planCode, seats: payload.subscription.seats, verificationEmailSent: vars.emailSent, verificationExpiresAt: vars.ids.expiresAtIso, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "PROVISIONING_FAILED", message: "Your account was created but workspace setup could not be started. Our team has been notified.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

db:update.doc:name: Store response
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE idempotency_keys SET response_body = :responseBody WHERE idempotency_key = :idempotencyKey

logger.message: #["Could not store idempotent response, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log store failure

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: vars.failure.code, message: vars.failure.message, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

logger.message: #["Verification request received, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log verification request

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import dw::Crypto import toHex from dw::core::Binaries output application/java --- toHex(Crypto::hashWith(vars.tokenParam as Binary, "SHA-256"))

db:select.doc:name: Find token by hash
db:select.db:sql: SELECT t.customer_id, t.consumed_at, CASE WHEN t.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_expired, c.account_status FROM verification_tokens t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE t.token_hash = :tokenHash

logger.message: #["Verification rejected: unknown token, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log unknown

set-variable.value: This verification link is not valid.

logger.message: #["Verification rejected: token already used, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log reused

set-variable.value: This verification link has already been used.

logger.message: #["Verification rejected: token expired, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log expired

set-variable.value: This verification link has expired. Please request a new one.

logger.message: #["Verification rejected: account not pending, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log not pending

set-variable.value: This account cannot be verified. Please contact support.

db:update.doc:name: Consume token once
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE verification_tokens SET consumed_at = NOW(), attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE token_hash = :tokenHash AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()

db:update.doc:name: Activate customer
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE customers SET account_status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = :customerId

db:update.doc:name: Activate user
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE customer_users SET user_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE customer_id = :customerId

logger.message: #["Account activated, customerId=" ++ vars.tokenRow[0].customer_id ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log activated

db:select.doc:name: Load customer for event
db:select.db:sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.tenant_id, c.company_name, c.plan_code, c.seats, c.region, u.email FROM customers c JOIN customer_users u ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id = :customerId

logger.message: #["Activation event published, customerId=" ++ vars.customerRow[0].customer_id ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log activation event published

logger.message: #["ALERT: ACTIVATION_EVENT_FAILED, customerId=" ++ vars.customerRow[0].customer_id ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Internal alert

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { customerId: vars.customerRow[0].customer_id, tenantId: vars.customerRow[0].tenant_id, accountStatus: "ACTIVE", message: "Email verified. Your account is now active.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

set-variable.value: This verification link has already been used.

logger.doc:name: Log resend request

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (payload.email is String) lower(trim(payload.email)) else ""

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: "One or more fields are invalid", correlationId: vars.correlationId, errors: [{ field: "email", message: "A valid email address is required" }] }

db:select.doc:name: Find account by email
db:select.db:sql: SELECT u.customer_id, u.first_name, c.account_status, c.company_name FROM customer_users u JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = u.customer_id WHERE u.email = :email

logger.message: #["Resend ignored: no pending account, correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log ignored

db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM verification_tokens WHERE customer_id = :customerId AND expires_at > DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 23 HOUR)

logger.message: #["Resend rate limit reached, customerId=" ++ vars.custRow[0].customer_id ++ ", correlationId=" ++ vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log rate limit

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "RESEND_RATE_LIMITED", message: "Too many verification emails were requested. Please try again later.", correlationId: vars.correlationId }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert new token hash
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO verification_tokens (token_hash, customer_id, email, expires_at) VALUES (:tokenHash, :customerId, :email, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR))
